steps.title: Create two backdrops
steps.instruction: Click on the Stage (bottom right), then click Backdrops tab. Create two backdrops: one with big text 'WAIT' and another with 'GO'.
steps.hint: Use the text tool (T) in the backdrop editor to add large text. Make WAIT red and GO green.

steps.title: Start with WAIT backdrop
steps.instruction: Click on the Stage, go to Code tab. Add 'when green flag clicked' and 'switch backdrop to WAIT'.
steps.hint: Make sure you're coding on the STAGE, not a sprite. Look for the stage icon in the bottom right.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]

steps.title: Add random wait time
steps.instruction: After switching to WAIT, add a 'wait' block with 'pick random 1 to 5' seconds inside it.
steps.hint: Control → wait ( ) seconds. Operators → pick random (1) to (5). Drag the pick random INTO the wait block.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds

steps.title: Reset timer and show GO
steps.instruction: Add 'reset timer' from Sensing, then 'switch backdrop to GO'.
steps.hint: Sensing → reset timer. Looks → switch backdrop to [GO].
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps.title: Capture reaction time
steps.instruction: Add 'when stage clicked' event. Then add 'say (timer) for 2 seconds' to show your reaction time.
steps.hint: Sensing → timer block goes inside the say block.
steps.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps.title: Test your reaction timer
steps.instruction: Click green flag, wait for GO to appear, then click anywhere on the stage. Your reaction time should appear!
steps.hint: Don't click too early! Wait for the backdrop to change to GO first.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds
